# Bundled third-party libraries

Loaded from Brum itself, so the page policy can stay limited to Brum's own scripts.
Downloaded from the npm registry; each package matched its published sha512 integrity.

| File | Package | Licence | sha256 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mermaid.min.js` | mermaid 10.9.8 | MIT (mermaid.LICENSE.txt) | `8d607d7ef1d077a8aa202e18e62212bfa992c68bfeabc5cf45d51a128fe6675d` |
| `three.min.js` | three 0.160.0 | MIT (three.LICENSE.txt) | `170c6789f43217c96b3170f4b42fafe135de7f7cd48497a4218f9757ee1d49fa` |
| `leaflet/leaflet.js` | leaflet 1.9.4 | BSD-2-Clause (leaflet/LICENSE.txt) | `db49d009c841f5ca34a888c96511ae936fd9f5533e90d8b2c4d57596f4e5641a` |
| `leaflet/leaflet.css` | leaflet 1.9.4 | BSD-2-Clause (leaflet/LICENSE.txt) | `a7837102824184820dfa198d1ebcd109ff6d0ff9a2672a074b9a1b4d147d04c6` |

Leaflet's marker and layer images are in `leaflet/images/`, next to its stylesheet.
